sentences.text:
With
 Can 1 of 2023
 Can 2 of 2023
 Cholamandalam
Ms General Insurance Company Ltd.

Vs.
 Manas Chatterjee & Ors.
 Mr. Soumalya Ganguly  ... for the appellant/Insurance Company  Mr. Anup Kumar Bag  ... for the respondents/claimants In Re: CAN 1 of 2023 The affidavit of service filed in Court today be kept on record.
The learned advocates for the respective parties are present.
The application being CAN 1 of 2023 under Section 5 of the limitation Act has been taken up for hearing.
From the record it reveals that there is a delay of 31 days.
Considering the averments made in the CAN application being 1 of 2023 and in view of the beneficial legislative intent the delay of 31 days in filing the instant case is condoned.
The application being CAN 1 of 2023 is allowed.
The Department is directed to register the appeal.
In Re: CAN 2 of 2023

As per the order of this Court dated 04.10.2023 the Insurance Company had deposited the entire awarded compensation before the office of the learned Registrar General, High Court at Calcutta vide OD Challan No. 2347 dated 17.11.2023.
Let the said challan be kept on record.
Accordingly, the interim order of stay dated 4th October, 2023 is made absolute and the stay shall continue till the disposal of the instant appeal.
The application being CAN 2 of 2023 is disposed of.
